title: Well the oppressors are trying to keep me down Trying to drive me underground And they think that they have got the battle won I say forgive them Lord
summary: Well the oppressors are trying to keep me down Trying to drive me underground And they think that they have got the battle won I say forgive them Lord They know not what they've done
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Well the oppressors are trying to keep me down
Trying to drive me underground
And they think that they have got the battle won
I say forgive them Lord
They know not what they've done
